newsitem.title: UK: BFI unchanged, grain chartering still active.
newsitem.headline: BFI unchanged, grain chartering still active.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was unchanged on Friday at 1,523 and brokers said active grain chartering continued in the Atlantic with rate levels broadly unchanged.

Cobelfret fixed Polish tonnage for 56,000 heavy grain USGulf to Ghent for mid-January at $14.25, down from Cargill's Mississippi/Holland rate with Maratha Majesty reported yesterday at $14.90 but regarded by brokers as a steady rate for a much more forward loading position.
Brokers also reported steadier conditons for Panamaxes in the North Pacific although rumours of Cargill's fixture of 54,000 heavy grain NoPac/Japan for early Janaury could not be confirmed.
Pan-Ocean fixed Angelic Spirit 65,767 dwt delivery retrospective sailing Japan two days ago for a North Pacific round at a steady $11,250 daily.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was eight to four points lower and turnover was only 30 lots.
